definition: JD Edwards CNC is the administration discipline for installing, configuring and operating the JD Edwards EnterpriseOne technical environment.
entry_text: JD Edwards CNC is the administration discipline for installing, configuring and operating the JD Edwards EnterpriseOne technical environment.
example: An administrator builds and deploys an EnterpriseOne application package to a test environment.
label: JD Edwards CNC

sources.note: Oracle names CNC the EnterpriseOne application architecture, while the draft defines the associated administrative discipline. Define the architecture first or explicitly name the skill as CNC administration; the deployment example is a plausible use.
